question: In Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree, what is the name of the colossal wicker fire giant enemies roaming the Realm of Shadow?
lore_fact: Furnace Golems are towering siege weapons powered by sacred burning heads crafted during Messmer the Impaler's crusade.
author: TarnishedChampion

question: What is the maximum player level cap in Fallout: New Vegas with all 4 story add-on DLCs installed?
lore_fact: Each of the 4 story add-on packs (Dead Money, Honest Hearts, Old World Blues, Lonesome Road) increased the level cap by 5, raising it from 30 to 50.
author: CourierSix
